import hashlib, os
W = r"C:\Users\10273\home\work\Z-Scope_1.31\Z-Scope\.coordination\20261014\workspaces\s08-owner"
C = r"C:\Users\10273\home\work\Z-Scope_1.31\Z-Scope\.coordination\20261014\checkpoints\s08-before-zcode-api-recovery"
mismatches = []
checked = 0
for base, dirs, files in os.walk(C):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ("__pycache__",)]
    for f in files:
        cp = os.path.join(base, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(cp, C)
        wp = os.path.join(W, rel)
        if not os.path.isfile(wp):
            mismatches.append(("missing-in-workspace", rel)); continue
        h1 = hashlib.sha256(open(cp,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
        h2 = hashlib.sha256(open(wp,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
        checked += 1
        if h1 != h2:
            mismatches.append(("changed", rel))
print("checked:", checked)
print("mismatches:", mismatches if mismatches else "NONE - workspace preserved")
EOF
